comment: Where the carved stele A-2 stands (doc/megaliths/A2_CARVED_STELE.md): a damp glade in the dark forest where it meets the white mountains and the green plateau, the stele in its middle. tools/terrain_lab/stele_glade.py picks the site and shapes the world round it (before marsh_islands.py and world_features.py); tools/terrain_lab/world_stele.py stands the stele and its fallen pieces there. Site: in `zone`, within `near` metres of each of those zones, at least `edge_m` inside its own, ground slope (over ~640 m) under `max_slope`, the lowest against the high ground round it (`hollow_km`); `site_m` [x, y] overrides the search (the lore world's hand). The glade: radius `radius_m` with a ragged rim (`wobble`; past `rim_core` of the radius its cells thin out into the forest's at random, out to `rim_out`), the ground eased to a plane keeping `keep_slope` of its fall, blended back over `blend_m`, dead flat within `flat_m` of the stele (the pond's level), hummocks `hummock_m`; it wears biome `biome` (biomes.json: mud and dark grass, dead trees in foliage.json). The pond in front of the stele (the asset's placement.foot.pond) is cut `pond_depth_m` deep, and `pools` more pools `pool_m` across, each on a flat `pool_flat_m` wider, at least `pool_gap_m` from the stele. The stele's front looks toward `face`.
